instructions.manual_exchange_notice: Upload this CHATGPT_PACKAGE.json independently in a fresh chat. VideoHoarder never uploads data automatically.

quality_rubric.grounding: Every material transcript-derived conclusion cites canonical segment_ids.
quality_rubric.coverage: Process every exact VIDEO_ID and every requested feature.
quality_rubric.semantic_synthesis: Write semantic summaries that consolidate meaning, argument, method and implications; do not concatenate or lightly rewrite transcript lines.
quality_rubric.timeline: Create boundaries only when the substantive topic changes; merge adjacent fragments about the same point.
quality_rubric.claims: Extract all consequential factual, medical, safety, financial, legal, causal, quantitative and recommendation claims; grade risk and external-verification need.
quality_rubric.entities: Perform named-entity recognition, merge aliases, type entities using the controlled list, and omit generic nouns.
quality_rubric.taxonomy: Use only controlled categories and canonical non-promotional tags.
quality_rubric.editorial: Make assessments specific to this video's evidence, value, limitations and audience; never reuse boilerplate.
quality_rubric.consistency: Use the same canonical evidence across summaries, timeline, claims, intake and editorial assessment.
quality_rubric.specificity: Preserve useful names, quantities, steps and qualifications; avoid generic filler.
quality_rubric.uncertainty: Distinguish source claims, supplied support, interpretation and external-verification needs.
quality_rubric.comments: Cluster only structured supplied comment records and report total, included count and sampling limitations; popularity is not factual verification.
quality_rubric.clips: Select only self-contained clips lasting 30-180 seconds, with valid non-overlapping timestamps and a video-specific purpose.

instructions.instructions: Use only the evidence embedded in this independently processed package and obey response_schema.feature_contracts, controlled_taxonomy, and formal_json_schema. Process every exact VIDEO_ID and return one final JSON object with no prose or markdown. All features must use the same canonical sentence-level transcript segments. Do not claim that you watched or listened to a video. Produce semantic synthesis rather than extractive transcript rewrites. Build timelines from meaningful topic boundaries. Perform complete risk-aware claim extraction and proper named-entity recognition. Make editorial_assessment.v1 a video-specific ChatGPT's Take, not boilerplate. Separate: (1) what the source says, (2) what the supplied evidence supports, (3) your interpretation, and (4) what remains uncertain or requires external verification. Cite canonical transcript segment_ids for transcript-derived conclusions. Downgrade confidence for partial/low evidence. If canonical segments are absent, do not produce transcript-derived summaries, timelines, claims, transcript-derived entities, or clips; metadata/comment-derived fields must identify their source and unsupported fields must be empty/unknown with the limitation. metadata.clean_title: How to get rid of Man Boobs Workout and Diet Tips
metadata.description:
Gynecomastia, also known as the Man Boobs is a common disorder of endocrine system in which there is non cancerous increase of male breast tissue. It is thought to be caused by an when the female sex hormone increases a little too much as compared to the it's male counterpart, the androgen.

Man boobs are common in new born babies but it hardly stays for 2-3 weeks. Then, it is also common in older males due to natural decline in testosterone. 
But, it is a major problem when it comes to adolescents. As many as 70% of them getting affected by it. 

Poor nutrition, side effects from medicines and use of steroids may also lead to man boobs.

So in this video, I share with you 7 tips including the specific exercises that will help you get rid of the man boobs. 

1. Lose weight 

There are high chances that after you lose fat, you will get rid of man boobs also. So eat a healthy and balanced diet and workout regularly to lose weight. I had recently written a detailed answer on "how to lose weight" on a website called Quora. You may want to check it out.

https://www.quora.com/What-is-the-best-way-to-reduce-belly-fat-and-overall-weight/answer/Vivek-Mittal-31

Follow the tips mentioned in this write up and you will see your fat percentage dropping.

2. Cut down Alcohol

Alcohol intake produces a suppression of plasma testosterone. 

3. Take no stress

I understand that this physical condition can be really embarrassing. However, it is not dangerous. Please do not feel stressed about it. Stress makes the cortisol level go up and testosterone level down making the condition even worse. 

4. Eat healthy fats

A male should consume around 70 grams of healthy fats everyday. Healthy fats boost our testosterone levels. Nuts, seeds, fish are some of the great options. Well, I have talked about healthy fats in detail in my grocery shopping video. Check it out by clicking on this link.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6whI1dKlJn4&t=3s

5. Sleep well

Again, lack of sleep can decrease our testosterone levels. So make sure you take a sound sleep of 7-8 hours daily. 

6. Leg workouts

Even a single leg workout session can improve the testosterone levels drastically. So, do not miss your leg workouts especially when you are dealing with man boobs. 

7. Gyno workout

Some of the specific exercises which will help you get rid of extra chest fat are bench press, inclined dumbbell press, pull over and dumbbell fly. There are some great push up exercises which will help you lose the chest fat. One of the most effective are close grip push ups, inclined push ups, elevated hand push ups.
Checkout my chest workout at home video wherein I share with you 9 different types of push ups which hit almost all areas of the chest.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BcRz4VIxQeo&t=4s

To add, one must avoid junk foods when suffering from this physical condition. However, if you are not able to control your cravings, checkout this video which may be very useful to you.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8hFr16_3cuI&t=2s

 In 75% of the cases, man boobs disappear automatically within a span of 18-24 months. However, even after following these tips if you are not able to get rid of them, I would suggest you to consult a doctor. 

Did you find this video helpful? If yes please do:

LIKE | SHARE | COMMENT

Please Subscribe:

https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCYC6Vcczj8v-Y5OgpEJTFBw

Music Credits : RetroVision by Puzzle.

Thank you so much for your time :)

I wish you good health.
Fit Tuber
